parameters.content:
This workflow is SUPPOSED to fail every time you run it - that's the test.

Before running: open Settings (top right) and set Core - Error Handler as the Error Workflow.

A successful test looks like: this execution shows red/failed in n8n, a new row appears in automation_runs with status=failed, and a critical notification appears.
